ball_mesh — DRIVE ballworld op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.ball_mesh(radius: 'float' = 0.02, subdiv: 'int' = 3, color=(1.0, 0.55, 0.05), marker_dir=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), marker_angle: 'float' = 25.0, marker_color=(0.05, 0.05, 0.05), markers=None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import ballworld; ballworld.ball_mesh(radius: 'float' = 0.02, subdiv: 'int' = 3, color=(1.0, 0.55, 0.05), marker_dir=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), marker_angle: 'float' = 25.0, marker_color=(0.05, 0.05, 0.05), markers=None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("ball_mesh"))

Usage

Ball mesh (origin = center) and markers. markers = [(dir, angle_deg), …] gives multiple markers (if None, 1 marker at marker_dir). Return value {"V", "F", "color" (M,3), "label" (M,) (23 or 24), "radius", "markers": [unit vector …]}.
